cohort: Pregnant ladies attending an obstetric OPD in Karkala taluk hospital in a rural community in Karnataka, India, including those classified as high-risk, moderate-risk, and low-risk.
finding: There was a significant association between quality of life and high-risk pregnancy, with high-risk pregnant ladies having a higher likelihood of poor quality of life.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as one of the common risk factors associated with high-risk pregnancy.
